activity.notes: A 1627 report described Tsouharissen as chief of the whole Neutral nation. Archaeological and ethnohistorical scholarship characterizes him as a paramount warrior-priest-chief over roughly ten constituent groups. The 1627 start is an explicit attestation point, not a claimed accession date; his death is placed around 1646.

sources.title: Tsouharissen's Chiefdom: An Early Historic 17th Century Neutral Iroquoian Ranked Society
sources.citation_text: The Canadian Journal of Archaeology abstract describes Tsouharissen as the paramount warrior-priest-chief of a ranked Neutral Iroquoian chiefdom and dates its florescence to his lifetime.
